findings.title: Schedule cancellation guidance contradicts cancellation of current scheduled run
findings.evidenceType: frozen UI/help source, SQL behavior and executed existing queued-run SQL assertion
reproduction: Create and claim due schedule; start scheduled run to populate last_run_id.
